Application Data.NAME: Community Trust Bank
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Community Trust Bank is a small community bank focused on providing personalized financial services to local residents and businesses. Our operations include deposit accounts, loan products, mortgage lending, and financial advisory services. We prioritize compliance with regulatory requirements and maintain a strong commitment to community engagement and responsible banking practices.
